verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission crew consists of four astronauts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Historic Crew of the Artemis II Mission... four specialists'; R2: 'four astronauts'; R3: 'four astronauts'; R7: 'Four astronauts have been selected'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state the crew consists of four astronauts.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission crew is scheduled for a 10-day lunar flyby mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The mission will last about 10 days... trajectory to the moon... come within 6,450 to 9,650 kilometers of the lunar surface'; R2: '10-day mission... orbit the Moon'; R5: '10-day journey... swinging around the moon'; R7: 'approximately 10-day mission... around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references confirm a ~10-day mission involving a lunar flyby/orbit.
